agent.title: Keyword retrieval refused 40% of a large suite
agent.detail: With the full 261-case suite, 109 cases were refused because loosely related permission rows (matched only by shared keywords) did not fit the context budget, even though the requirement each story names did. The budget now keeps every exact-ID match and drops lower-ranked keyword-only matches with a recorded gap (ADR-0010, with a test). Drafted cases rose from 152 to 216 with the same sources; the evaluation gates still pass.

agent.title: The functional requirements were missing from the sources
agent.detail: 27 cases cite functional requirements (FR-LEAD-006, FR-CUS-003, …) from Gym CRM's 06_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS.md, which was not loaded. The agent correctly refused them ("unsupported" or "no trusted context") instead of inventing support. Adding the document (76 FR rules, one block each) brought drafted cases to 259 of 261.

agent.title: Test results depended on the machine's language
agent.detail: The executor did not pin a browser locale, so Gym CRM rendered its login page in Vietnamese on one machine and English on another, and the same spec failed on one of them. The executor now pins en-US by default (configurable), with a test.

agent.title: A redirect could make a passing test inconclusive
agent.detail: Gym CRM redirects /finance to /finance/payments on the client at an unpredictable moment after load. The screenshot taken after the navigation step sometimes raced it (3 of 25 runs). Navigation screenshots are now supporting evidence: if one cannot be captured, the step log says why and the run continues. Assertion screenshots stay mandatory. After the fix: 0 inconclusive runs in 50.

agent.title: Redaction mangled secret names in reproduction notes
agent.detail: The reproduction write-up showed the password step as [secret:[REDACTED] because the redactor treated the reference name as a value. The secret was never exposed. References of the exact form [secret:NAME] are now kept; real values in brackets are still redacted. Test added.

agent.title: Locators could not reach Gym CRM's dropdowns and dialogs
agent.detail: Gym CRM uses custom dropdowns (a listbox of options), a main landmark, and an alert dialog for the duplicate-phone warning. The allowed ARIA roles gained main, listbox, option and alertdialog. No new step type was added (ADR-0008).

agent.title: No test suites
agent.detail: The agent managed single cases and runs only. It now has test suites: named sets of cases in sections, run together, with a suite-run report of per-case verdicts, durations, evidence and traceability (migration 0005, API, tests). Manual and unapproved cases are listed in every run, never counted as passed.

agent.title: Failure text and matching use different views of the page
agent.detail: expectText matches an element's text content, but a failure reports its rendered text. On Gym CRM the two differ ("Còn lại21" versus "Còn lại" and "21" on separate lines; amounts end in a non-breaking space before ₫), which made one assertion harder to write. Worth documenting or reporting both views.

agent.title: Sources needed careful preparation
agent.detail: Whole business-rule sections overflowed the budget (28 of 30 criteria refused), so sources hold one block per rule and per permission row, the latter restated as "granted to" lists. Preparing sources is part of the setup cost.

product.title: Price preview shows a raw English validation message (CON-07)
product.detail: Found by boundary-value analysis on the contract form. Typing 1001 sessions makes the live price panel show "Too big: expected number to be <=1000", an untranslated developer message, in the Vietnamese UI. Gym CRM's own catalog has the right text ("Nhập một số nguyên từ 1 đến 1000."), which the form does show on save, and 0 shows the normal placeholder. Low severity: nothing is saved. Reproduced in both suite runs.

product.title: The not-found page has two main landmarks (SEC-01)
product.detail: Opening a record id that does not exist renders one <main> nested inside another, both holding "Không tìm thấy". A page should have a single main landmark for assistive technology. In the first two runs the automated check came back INCONCLUSIVE because its strict locator refused to guess between them; it now asserts the "Không tìm thấy" heading and passes, and the nested landmarks remain to be fixed.

product.title: 130 of 131 automated checks pass, identically in two runs (third run)
product.detail: Sign-in, every page of the permission matrix (60 checks across 30 pages and 6 roles, all matching docs/09), lead validation and boundaries, duplicates, search, customer standings, contract pricing boundaries, locked and derived contract values, finance access and API refusals behave as the requirements say.

product.title: Two definitions of "ending soon"
product.detail: The customer badge "Sắp hết hạn" follows decision A-131: only the end date (within 30 days). The dashboard's "contracts ending soon" uses 30 days or 3 sessions or fewer, and the demo seed calls a customer with 2 sessions left "ending soon". Both behave as their own rule says, but the two rules disagree; worth a product owner decision.

product.title: The sign-in limit is not "20 per minute"
product.detail: Gym CRM configures Better Auth with 20 sign-ins per 60 seconds per IP, and its comment says the limit must let a whole shift sign in from the gym's one shared IP. Better Auth (1.7.7) resets the counter only after 60 seconds without a successful sign-in, and every successful sign-in restarts that wait. So after 20 sign-ins with gaps under a minute, everyone behind the gym's IP is refused (HTTP 429) until a full quiet minute passes. Observed: blocks after 20 sign-ins at about 11 per minute. Worth a sliding window or a higher limit for the shared IP.

product.title: AC-04 is enforced on the server
product.detail: Saving a lead with channel "Khác" and no note is refused by the server, not only by the form: the field shows "Đã chọn \"Khác\" thì phải ghi rõ" and a toast reports invalid data.

product.title: Duplicate phones get a clear merge prompt
product.detail: Entering an existing customer's phone opens "Số điện thoại đã có hồ sơ", names the record (KH000001 · Nguyễn Văn An) and offers "Gộp vào hồ sơ này" or "Quay lại sửa".

product.title: The sidebar is not a navigation landmark
product.detail: The main menu has no <nav> element, ARIA navigation role or test ids, so assistive technology cannot jump to it and tests cannot scope menu links to it.

product.title: The demo data's draft contract is approved
product.detail: The demo seed describes Bùi Thanh Tâm's contract (HD000008) as "a draft, not activated yet", but it shows "Đang hiệu lực", approved by Admin, likely because the seed approves every pending request afterwards. The demo therefore has no pending contract for booking tests.
